tool_input.command: echo "PWD: $(pwd)" && echo "---ENV---" && env | grep -E "GCP_|MLPAB_|GOOGLE_" | sed 's/\(CREDENTIALS=\).*/\1<redacted>/' && echo "---DATA---" && ls -la data/ && echo "---HEAD---" && head -5 data/prediction_log.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l data/prediction_log.csv

tool_input.description: Read schema and tail of data
Load prediction log CSV into BigQuery

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --location="$GCP_LOCATION" --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(ts) AS min_ts, MAX(ts) AS max_ts, MIN(prediction) AS min_p, MAX(prediction) AS max_p, AVG(prediction) AS avg_p
FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.'"${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}"'_prediction_log`'

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --location="$GCP_LOCATION" --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv '
SELECT DATE(ts) AS day, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(prediction),4) mean, ROUND(STDDEV(prediction),4) sd
FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.'"${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}"'_prediction_log`
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day' 2>/dev/null

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --location="$GCP_LOCATION" --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT DATE(ts) day, AVG(prediction) m
  FROM `'"$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.'"${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}"'_prediction_log`
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT day AS onset_day, ROUND(m,4) mean_today, ROUND(prev,4) mean_prev, ROUND(m-prev,4) jump
FROM (SELECT day, m, LAG(m) OVER (ORDER BY day) prev FROM daily)
ORDER BY ABS(m-prev) DESC LIMIT 3'
mkdir -p submission && printf '{"onset": "2026-02-26"}\n' > submission/answers.json && cat submission/answers.json
